neighbours.label: the word introducing the clock time of an incident in news reports ('at' around 8 p.m., 'just' after 11pm, 'early' Monday)
fire: Police said the man was arrested at about 9 p.m. outside a bar.

notes: Card: ' at' x11, ' on' x5, ' early' x3 of top 32, all right before the time of a crime/accident in local news; output suppresses ' around', weekday names. Near misses keep the news report but give no time (place or manner instead) and avoid 'at'.
